title: One week to go until MXP Sydney on 12 November
summary: Join MXP Sydney on November 12 for expert insights on product intelligence, AI, data-driven decisions, and innovation in tech.
body_markdown:
One week to go. Sydney, are you in?


🇦🇺


A week from now, we’ll be bringing some of Australia’s leading product, technology and data voices together at MXP Sydney. What’s on the agenda?


-


J


en Taylor


,


Anant Gupta


and

-

[OFX](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ofx/) .

-

Jonathan Wermut

-


Round table discussion on AI measurement, experimentation and leading teams through change.


Don't miss a day of insights, ideas and conversations with the people shaping what's next.
